central_claims.claim: 3D Gaussian Field spatially binds geometry and semantics before distillation.
central_claims.what_it_actually_proves: PDF describes multi-view VGGT/CLIP signals initialized and fitted in Gaussian primitives, then rendered to WAM-aligned targets.
central_claims.what_it_does_not_prove: No independent ground-truth 3D validation or proof of superiority over every alignment alternative.

central_claims.claim: Training-only Gaussian distillation improves WAM robustness without extra inference modules.
central_claims.what_it_actually_proves: Matched reported settings show overall success gains and Gaussian modules are removed from deployment path.
central_claims.what_it_does_not_prove: No wall-clock latency, training/cache cost, confidence intervals, or arbitrary-real-world generalization.

central_claims.claim: Spatial unification adds value beyond direct CLIP+VGGT losses.
central_claims.what_it_actually_proves: Direct 69.37, Gaussian no-alpha 70.99, full 71.29 in the reported FastWAM comparison.
central_claims.what_it_does_not_prove: Unification gain is small and not fully isolated from capacity, mask, head, or seed confounds.

central_claims.claim: Depth, semantic and alpha supervision are complementary, with depth largest single ablation drop.
central_claims.what_it_actually_proves: Removing each component lowers overall; depth removal reaches 66.28.
central_claims.what_it_does_not_prove: VGGT pseudo-depth is not real depth ground truth.

claim_boundaries: VGGT-Omega depth and CLIP features are pseudo/teacher targets.
RoboTwin Random absolute success remains low.
Depth probe uses VGGT pseudo-depth and t-SNE is qualitative.
No appendix, seeds, CIs, full renderer config, or end-to-end cost reported.
negative_or_limiting_results: Intermediate layers win some shifts but lose overall.
mechanism_result_map: Shared 3D carrier and multi-view rendering align with gains under camera/robot/light/noise shifts.
Alpha validity gate is auxiliary; removing it causes only a small overall drop.
comparative_positioning: Adds training-time geometry/semantic teacher to 2D WAM; uses shared spatial carrier versus independent losses; removes 3D path at inference versus explicit 3D/4D WAM.
reuse_takeaways: Align heterogeneous teachers in common physical coordinates.
Use renderer coverage as a validity gate.
Decompose teacher gain from organization gain.
followup_questions: Does gain persist with calibrated depth and object-level correspondence?
Does it work single-view or with different camera counts?
What are fitting/cache cost and failure rates?
Does the 1.62-point gain survive capacity/mask/seed controls?
